_comment: Newest first. tools/release_page_build.py renders the website's download section, changelog, website/version.json and the GitHub release notes from this file plus pubspec.yaml and the built APKs. The first entry must match the pubspec version.

releases.summary_en: Shared tablets and privacy. A child's alarm now rings only for that child and the grown-up who set it: another learner, teacher or parent using the same tablet no longer sees it, alarms left behind by older versions are cleared, and the notification shows the child's name. Restoring a backup brings back only your own custom cards, and the app asks the cloud only for this tablet's own profiles. Installs over v1.2.1 and keeps your profiles.
releases.summary_fil: Para sa magkakasamang tablet at privacy. Tumutunog na lang ang alarma ng isang bata para sa batang iyon at sa nakatatandang nag-set nito: hindi na ito makikita ng ibang mag-aaral, guro o magulang na gumagamit ng parehong tablet, nabubura ang mga alarmang naiwan ng lumang bersyon, at nakasulat na sa notification ang pangalan ng bata. Kapag nag-restore ng backup, sariling custom card lang ang bumabalik, at sariling profile lang ng tablet na ito ang hinihingi ng app sa cloud. Nai-i-install sa ibabaw ng v1.2.1 at nananatili ang inyong mga profile.
releases.notes_en: Alarms ring only for the child they are for on shared tablets, and backups restore only your own cards.
releases.notes_fil: Sa magkakasamang tablet, para lang sa tamang bata ang alarma, at sariling card lang ang naibabalik ng backup.
bullets_en: A child's alarm rings only for that child (and the grown-up who set it), never in another learner's, teacher's or parent's session
Alarms left behind by older versions are cleared when another learner signs in
Alarm notifications show the child's name
Restoring a backup brings back only your own custom cards

releases.summary_en: Safety and polish. The app now tells teachers and parents when a newer version is on this website (Settings → Check for updates, and a card on their home screen). Profile recovery codes are better protected. Usage statistics and crash reports stay off until a teacher or parent turns them on, and the app no longer carries the advertising ID permission. The AI Tutor bubble no longer covers pop-ups, pickers or buttons. Installs over v1.2.0 and keeps your profiles.
releases.summary_fil: Kaligtasan at pagpapaganda. Sasabihin na ng app sa mga guro at magulang kapag may mas bagong bersyon sa website na ito (Settings → Tingnan kung may update, at isang card sa kanilang home screen). Mas protektado na ang mga recovery code ng profile. Nakapatay ang usage statistics at crash reports hanggang buksan ito ng guro o magulang, at wala na sa app ang advertising ID permission. Hindi na tinatakpan ng AI Tutor bubble ang mga pop-up, picker o button. Nai-i-install sa ibabaw ng v1.2.0 at nananatili ang inyong mga profile.
releases.notes_en: Update notices for teachers and parents, safer recovery codes, analytics off until an adult turns it on, and the AI Tutor bubble no longer covers pop-ups.
releases.notes_fil: Paalala ng update para sa guro at magulang, mas ligtas na recovery code, nakapatay ang analytics hanggang buksan ng matanda, at hindi na tinatakpan ng AI Tutor bubble ang mga pop-up.
bullets_en: **Check for updates** in Settings, and a "new version" card on teacher and parent homes
Profile recovery codes can no longer be listed by other tablets
Usage statistics and crash reports stay off until a teacher or parent turns them on; no advertising ID
The AI Tutor bubble no longer covers pop-ups, pickers or the guest home's buttons

releases.summary_en: Second public release. New: My Day picture schedules with reminders, set up by a teacher or parent; the Talk Board for speaking by tapping pictures; a daily mood check-in; class pre- and post-tests with pictures, sound, FSL video and video answers, plus a learner portfolio PDF for parents; Messages between teachers, parents and children, with blocking and reporting; offline sign packs; a Progress tab shaped to each learner; and a complete Filipino interface. Text on every theme now meets WCAG AA contrast, along with many fixes from classroom testing. Installs over v1.0.0 and keeps your profiles.
releases.summary_fil: Ikalawang pampublikong labas. Bago: My Day — larawang iskedyul na may paalala na inihahanda ng guro o magulang; ang Talk Board para magsalita sa pag-tap ng larawan; araw-araw na mood check-in; pre-test at post-test ng klase na may larawan, tunog, FSL video at sagot na video, pati portfolio PDF para sa magulang; Messages sa pagitan ng guro, magulang at bata, na may block at report; offline sign packs; Progress tab na angkop sa bawat mag-aaral; at buong Filipino na interface. Pasado na sa WCAG AA contrast ang teksto sa bawat tema, kasama ang maraming ayos mula sa pagsubok sa klase. Nai-i-install sa ibabaw ng v1.0.0 at nananatili ang inyong mga profile.
releases.notes_en: My Day routines, the Talk Board, mood check-ins, class pre/post tests with media, Messages, offline sign packs and a full Filipino interface.
releases.notes_fil: My Day, Talk Board, mood check-in, pre/post test ng klase na may media, Messages, offline sign packs at buong Filipino na interface.
bullets_en: **My Day**: picture schedules with reminders, set up by a teacher or parent
A daily mood check-in on the home screen
Class **pre- and post-tests** with pictures, sound, FSL video and video answers, plus a learner portfolio PDF for parents
**Messages** between teachers, parents and children, with blocking and reporting
Offline sign packs, a Progress tab shaped to each learner, and a complete Filipino interface
Text on every theme meets WCAG AA contrast, plus many fixes from classroom testing

releases.summary_en: First public release: 177 bilingual words in 13 decks, 15 learning games, stories with comprehension questions, FSL practice, AI learning companion, and the full accessibility suite (high contrast, dyslexia-friendly, reduced motion, voice-guided navigation, gaze & voice control).
releases.summary_fil: Unang pampublikong labas: 177 salita sa 13 deck, 15 laro, mga kuwento na may tanong, FSL practice, AI learning companion, at kumpletong accessibility suite (high contrast, dyslexia-friendly, reduced motion, voice-guided navigation, gaze at voice control).
